WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS mean_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.average_rate_per_day,
       r.average_rate_per_day - o.mean_average AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE r.average_rate_per_day > o.mean_average;
